title: Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom

Bitcoin price recovered from an early-morning low near $79,400 to trade around $80,500 on Tuesday, holding above $80,000 ahead of this week’s Fed decision and the November midterms.

This post Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure

VanEck launched its Wealth Builder ETF (WBMO) on the NYSE, bundling stocks, bonds, gold and indirect bitcoin exposure into one fund for 0.26% a year.
